limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false and partial scope coverage. Native passes do not establish complete scientific review, measured quotation coverage, generated-product currency, full QC or campaign completion.

Source coverage is the complete current record and retained primary abstract for PMID23949950, plus exact native source preparation and historical caller/ledger. No full article, original figures, supplement, genotype table, source assembly or raw data was acquired or audited.

The abstract describes a collection of 336 cultured spore-forming isolates from five saline sites, marker-based placement into seven genera, and 14 BOX-PCR genotypes among 42 isolates of the most frequent ITS type. These are distinct sampling populations, not a seven-strain synthetic community or proof of in situ co-occurrence.

Halobacillus trueperi remains the source preferred name and exact NCBI descriptor. Its native species-ID majority is GTDB Halobacillus aidingensis with total_genomes 7 and fraction 0.86. No support numerator is inferred from that rounded fraction; no study isolate or genome is reidentified.

The selected genus populations are Bacillus 4981/8737 at fraction 0.57, Virgibacillus 91/150 at 0.607, Oceanobacillus 107/129 at 0.829, Gracilibacillus 64/64, and Pontibacillus 23/29 at 0.793. These are filtered reference populations, not isolate frequencies, environmental abundance, salinity growth classes or functional-role measurements.

Native status traversal processes seven descriptors but only six change. Paenibacillus index 5, its AMBIGUOUS status and all 33 ordered native alternatives remain unchanged. Every original stock field, preferred term, NCBI label and source quotation is preserved.

The source reports geographic correlation of genotype distribution and a qualified suggestion of marine origin. It does not directly show that salinity adaptation causes that distribution. The existing outgoing causal wording and ecological collection interpretation remain under the captured OPEN issue 2924, together with unqualified PRIMARY_DEGRADER roles.

Measured salinity growth classes, isolation frequencies and marker diversity remain distinct from environmental abundance or ecological mechanism. Preserved current biological predicates and the old DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED ledger decision do not constitute a new scientific endorsement.

Actual staging, application and all eight native checks ran at frozen M5 revision 261941db9aa5c359dc7599f28e4648a6c9723396 with Python 3.13.2; each actual gate followed its free plan. The native sidecar binds the actual apply receipt and describes six changed descriptors, not seven.

Crosswalk SHA761d5537 has an unestablished release. NCBI authority is observed by file identity/stat, not a whole-database digest. Native terms reports validation passed without an assertion denominator; it is not measured reference-quotation validation.

The immutable batch 135 ledger and all current biological predicates remain protected. After complete saved-input capture, the bounded leaf may add only strict 494 admission while preserving the captured 491 path. Root will compose its separately accepted 492 admission in the maintained integration branch; no unrelated proof closure is imported here.

The captured issue 2924 snapshot is an explicit additional provenance input through the unchanged wrapper. No issue disposition, graph correction, paper-level scientific clearance or new source acquisition is claimed.
